name: Rock City Climbing
address: 16942 Gothard St Ste G, Huntington Beach, CA 92647

coord_source.ref: Nominatim house-number match for "16942 Gothard Street, Huntington Beach, CA" (OSM way/399477468)

research_notes: Orange County's long-running Rock City Climbing, now a Huntington Beach "training center" (moved from Anaheim; the site's map link still points at the old Anaheim coordinates 33.858,-117.806, which were NOT used). Own site (read 2026-10-13): address 16942 Gothard St Ste G, opening hours Mo-Fr 12-22, Sa 10-20, Su 10-18 (schema.org block), a Purchase a Pass page with a "Single Visit - $27" drop-in day visit, and an equipment page listing a 24x12 ft spray wall, a 24x14 ft World Cup comp-style setting wall, a multi-purpose skills wall, a 32 ft slab wall and a Tension Board 2 (no ropes, bouldering-style terrain; the word "bouldering" is not used). Hours page: training-center access is limited by staffing, team practices and competition travel. A 30 June 2026 California.com guide lists Rock City in Huntington Beach among the OC gyms. Pin: Nominatim house-number match for 16942 Gothard Street (OSM way 399477468). Weaker accept: see MANUAL-CHECK.md optional spot check.

name: Touchstone Team Training Center
research_notes: Touchstone page (read 2026-10-13): "A Touchstone Members-Only Climbing Gym" across the street from Berkeley Ironworks, 15 ft bouldering walls, comp-style walls and training boards, weekdays 6-21:30, weekends 9-18:30; "open to non-Team Touchstone members during select hours" (check in at Ironworks). Members-only facility with limited public hours, so not accepted as a day-visit gym.

name: Desert Rocks Indoor Climbing Gym
address: 19160 McLane St, North Palm Springs, CA 92258

The gym's listed domain climbdesertrocks.com is now an unrelated review/spam blog (2023 posts), so no primary source was readable; an undated Palm Springs Life profile describes a 7,000 sq ft gym with 30 ft walls (rope-oriented). name: Bladium Sports & Fitness Club (Rock Wall and Bouldering Gym)
research_notes: OSM fitness-centre node "Bladium Sports & Fitness Club" at 800 W Tower Ave. A summer-camp listing describes a "Rock Wall and Bouldering Gym" of 5,000 sq ft with a 35 ft wall, but bladiumalameda.com and bladium.com refuse connections (ECONNREFUSED) from the research network, so no primary source could be read and whether the club still operates is unknown.
